title: Wearable Biometric Authentication SLR: data and analysis code for "A Meta-Analytical Audit of Robustness, Reproducibility, and Deployability in Wearable Biometric Systems"
description: Data extraction outputs and analysis code for a PRISMA-guided meta-analytical audit of 263 wearable biometric authentication studies (2017-2026). Includes the LLM-assisted, human-verified per-study extraction records, the de-duplicated corpus, the scripts that regenerate every statistic, figure and table in the manuscript, and Supplementary Table S1 (full extraction matrix).
